fact: WHO says Eswatini introduced DHIS2 nationally in 2024 through the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of ICT and WHO, with test and production servers set up, 25 Strategic Information Officers trained in DHIS2 configuration and the national M&E team mentored for national ownership, and that limited local hosting capacity and continued dependency on external technical support put the system's sustainability at risk.
title: Eswatini 2024 Annual Report
